responsibility: Defines x86 and x86_64 inline-assembly register classes and registers, including size and vector modifiers, type-driven register suggestions, architecture-specific reserved-register validation, emitted register spelling across subregister views, and overlap relationships among GPR byte/word forms and XMM/YMM/ZMM aliases.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/x86.rs`, this x86 file defines the inline `asm!` register universe for x86/x86_64—subregister modifiers, byte/high-byte constraints, vector register aliasing, emitted spellings, and reserved-register validation—rather than function-call ABI lowering.
